en: Colorized historic street scene showing a wide boulevard lined with ornate multi‑story buildings, trams and horse‑drawn carriages moving along cobblestone streets, and pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing. A large rounded‑corner theater building stands to the left, and another grand building with cupolas and a hotel sign is on the right. The sky is softly tinted, typical of vintage postcards.
